newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen H1 passenger numbers up 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen H1 passenger numbers up 5.4 pct.

text.p: Vienna airport operator Flughafen Wien said on Friday passenger numbers in the first six months of the year gained 5.4 percent, but added that the rate of growth had declined from the year-ago period.
"The reasons lie in the economic development in Europe as well as the fact that the tapping of new markets has become more difficult despite the fall in flight prices," Flughafen said in a statement.
In the first half of 1996, passenger numbers had risen by 8.1 percent over the same period in 1995.
In the first half of this year it handled 4.486 million passengers.
Flughafen also showed a worrying development in take-off and landings, which fell 0.4 percent in the first half after a rise of 10.9 percent in the first half of 1996.
Maximum take off weight (MTOW) also declined, down 1.6 percent from the year-ago period, mainly due to less flight movement.
However, air cargo and trucking showed a significant improvement from March onwards with 67,717 tonnes handled, up 10.8 percent.
The company said that since the first half of the year is traditionally weak, it expects to see positive results in all traffic areas by the end of the year. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
